# Magento (Adobe Commerce) MCP connector

Drive Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce from any AI agent: products (also per store view), categories, attribute options, stock per source and low-stock items, special prices, orders and credit memos, … The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 48 MCP tools for Magento (Adobe Commerce): 26 read and 22 can change data.

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Magento (Adobe Commerce) connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Magento (Adobe Commerce) connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Magento (Adobe Commerce) account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/magento-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-magento-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-magento-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-magento-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-magento-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-magento-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-magento-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Show me order 10004523: status, billing name, shipped date and grand total.*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Magento (Adobe Commerce) API"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, a bearer token" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Magento (Adobe Commerce) credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (a bearer token), calls Magento (Adobe Commerce), logs the call and returns the result.
- **Magento (Adobe Commerce)** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/magento.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/magento.json).

### `magento_list_store_views`

List the store views of the Magento / Adobe Commerce instance (id, code, name, website). A cheap read that also confirms the access token works.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /store/storeViews`

No parameters.

### `magento_search_products`

Search products with Magento's search criteria DSL. Filter by SKUs, name, status and visibility; filters combine with AND.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /products`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku_in` | string | no | Comma-separated SKUs (matches with condition_type=in). |
| `name_like` | string | no | Name pattern for a LIKE match; wrap it in % for a substring, e.g. %shirt%. |
| `status` | integer | no | 1=enabled, 2=disabled. |
| `visibility` | integer | no | 1=not visible, 2=catalog only, 3=search only, 4=catalog+search. |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Per page (default 20, max ~300 due to URL length). |
| `currentPage` | integer | no | 1-based page. |
| `sortOrders_field` | string | no | Sort field (e.g. 'created_at', 'price'). |
| `sortOrders_direction` | string | no | ASC or DESC. |

### `magento_get_product`

Fetch a single product by SKU. Returns full attributes including custom_attributes[].

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /products/{sku}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku` | string | yes | Product SKU (URL-encode if contains special chars). |

### `magento_create_product`

Create a product. Required: product.sku + product.name + product.type_id + product.attribute_set_id + product.price.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /products`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product` | object | yes | {sku, name, type_id:'simple'\|'configurable'\|'virtual'\|'bundle'\|'grouped'\|'downloadable', attribute_set_id:N (usually 4 for default), price, status?:1, visibility?:4, weight?, custom_attributes?:[{attribute_code,value}], extension_attributes?:{stock_item:{qty,is_in_stock}}}. |
| `saveOptions` | boolean | no | If true, save configurable options too. |

### `magento_update_product`

Update a product by SKU: send only the fields to change (name, price, status, visibility, custom attributes...). Changes the live catalog: confirm with the user first.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /products/{sku}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku` | string | yes | Product SKU. |
| `product` | object | yes | Partial product object: only the fields to change. |

### `magento_update_product_in_scope`

Update a product by SKU in a chosen scope: storeCode all (default) writes the global values every store view inherits; a store view code writes values for that view only (a translated name, a view price where prices are per website). Send only the fields to change. Prefer all unless the user wants a view-specific value. Changes the live catalog: confirm with the user first.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/products/{sku}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | all for the global scope, or a store view code from magento_list_store_views, e.g. de. |
| `sku` | string | yes | Product SKU. |
| `product` | object | yes | Partial product object: only the fields to change, e.g. {"name": "Mug", "custom_attributes": [{"attribute_code": "description", "value": "..."}]}. |

### `magento_delete_product`

Delete a product by SKU from the catalog. This cannot be undone; to take a product offline set its status to 2 (disabled) with magento_update_product instead.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `DELETE /products/{sku}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku` | string | yes | SKU to delete. |

### `magento_update_stock`

Update inventory stock for a SKU at a source. For single-source (default 'default' source).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /products/{sku}/stockItems/1`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku` | string | yes | SKU. |
| `stockItem` | object | yes | {qty:N, is_in_stock:bool, manage_stock?:bool, min_qty?, max_sale_qty?}. |

### `magento_list_low_stock_items`

List stock items whose quantity is below a threshold: product id, SKU, qty, in-stock flag and low-stock date. Uses the legacy catalog inventory (single source); on shops that run Multi-Source Inventory the per-source quantities live elsewhere and this list can be empty.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /stockItems/lowStock/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qty` | number | yes | Threshold: items with a quantity below this value are returned, e.g. 5. |
| `scopeId` | integer | yes | Stock scope (website) id; 0 is the default stock used by single-source shops. |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Results per page, e.g. 50. |
| `currentPage` | integer | no | 1-based page. |

### `magento_list_categories`

Return the category tree (id, name, active flag, product count and children) from a root category down to a depth.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /categories`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rootCategoryId` | integer | no | Root category ID. Default 1 (root). |
| `depth` | integer | no | Depth of tree to return. |

### `magento_search_orders`

Search orders by status, customer e-mail and creation date window: increment id, state, totals, items, addresses and payment. Pages with pageSize and currentPage.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /orders`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | no | pending, processing, complete, closed, canceled, holded. |
| `customer_email` | string | no | Filter by customer email. |
| `created_at_from` | string | no | ISO 8601; orders created after this time. |
| `created_at_to` | string | no | ISO 8601; orders created before this time. |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Per page. |
| `currentPage` | integer | no | 1-based page. |

### `magento_get_order`

Fetch one order by ID with billing/shipping addresses, items[], status history.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /orders/{orderId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | integer | yes | Order ID (entity_id). |

### `magento_cancel_order`

Cancel an order (only valid in pending/processing status). Returns true on success.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /orders/{orderId}/cancel`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | integer | yes | Order ID. |

### `magento_create_guest_cart`

Start a new empty guest cart (a quote, not yet an order) in a store view and return its cart id for the other guest cart tools. Installed switched off together with the rest of the cart flow.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |

### `magento_get_guest_cart`

Read a guest cart: items (SKU, name, qty, price, item id), customer e-mail, addresses, currency and whether it is still active (false once an order was placed from it).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |

### `magento_add_guest_cart_item`

Add a product to a guest cart by SKU and quantity. Simple products only need sku and qty; a configurable or bundle product also needs product_option with the chosen options. Returns the cart item with its price. Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/items`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |
| `sku` | string | yes | Product SKU. |
| `qty` | number | yes | Quantity to add. |
| `product_option` | object | no | Only for configurable or bundle products, e.g. {"extension_attributes": {"configurable_item_options": [{"option_id": "93", "option_value": 52}]}}. |

### `magento_apply_guest_cart_coupon`

Apply a coupon (discount) code to a guest cart; Magento answers 404 when the code does not exist or does not apply. Check the discount with magento_get_guest_cart_totals. Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/coupons/{couponCode}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |
| `couponCode` | string | yes | The coupon code. |

### `magento_estimate_guest_cart_shipping`

List the shipping methods and prices available for a guest cart to an address: carrier_code, method_code, amount and availability. Pass the codes to magento_set_guest_cart_shipping. Read-only although it is a POST.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/estimate-shipping-methods`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |
| `address` | object | yes | Destination; country_id is enough for a rough estimate, add postcode and region for an exact one. Address object: {"firstname": "...", "lastname": "...", "street": ["..."], "city": "...", "postcode": "...", "country_id": "NL", "region": "...", "telephone": "...", "email": "..."}. |

### `magento_set_guest_cart_shipping`

Set the shipping address, billing address and shipping method of a guest cart. Returns the payment methods available and the totals. Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/shipping-information`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |
| `addressInformation` | object | yes | {"shipping_address": {...}, "billing_address": {...}, "shipping_carrier_code": "flatrate", "shipping_method_code": "flatrate"}. The codes come from magento_estimate_guest_cart_shipping. Address object: {"firstname": "...", "lastname": "...", "street": ["..."], "city": "...", "postcode": "...", "country_id": "NL", "region": "...", "telephone": "...", "email": "..."}. |

### `magento_list_guest_cart_payment_methods`

List the payment methods the guest cart can use (code and title, e.g. checkmo, banktransfer, cashondelivery, free). Available once the shipping information is set.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/payment-methods`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |

### `magento_get_guest_cart_totals`

Read the totals of a guest cart: subtotal, discount (with the applied coupon), shipping, tax and grand total per item and overall, in the store view's currency.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/totals`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |

### `magento_place_guest_order`

Place the order from a guest cart: sets the customer e-mail, payment method and billing address and turns the cart into a real order, which Magento confirms to the customer by e-mail. Returns the order id (use magento_get_order). Creates a binding order: installed switched off. Show the items, totals, address and payment method to the user and wait for a yes.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/{storeCode}/V1/guest-carts/{cartId}/payment-information`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `storeCode` | string | yes | Store view code the cart belongs to (prices, currency and language of that view), from magento_list_store_views, e.g. default. Use the same code for every call on one cart. |
| `cartId` | string | yes | The guest cart id (a 32-character masked id) returned by magento_create_guest_cart. |
| `email` | string | yes | Customer e-mail for the order. |
| `paymentMethod` | object | yes | {"method": "checkmo"}; the code comes from magento_list_guest_cart_payment_methods. |

### `magento_find_carts`

Search shopping carts (quotes) of the store, for example open carts with items to follow up abandoned baskets: cart id, active flag, customer, item count, items with SKU, quantity and price, totals and dates. Filter e.g. is_active eq 1 and items_count gt 0 and updated_at gteq a date. Carts carry customer names and addresses; use fields to keep only what is needed.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /carts/search`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter1_field` | string | no | Field of filter 1, e.g. is_active (1 open), customer_email, items_count (gt 0), updated_at (gteq 2026-10-01 00:00:00). |
| `filter1_value` | string | no | Value of filter 1; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas. |
| `filter1_condition` | `eq` \| `neq` \| `like` \| `nlike` \| `in` \| `nin` \| `gt` \| `lt` \| `gteq` \| `lteq` \| `null` \| `notnull` \| `from` \| `to` | no | Comparison of filter 1; Magento uses eq when left out. |
| `filter2_field` | string | no | Field of filter 2; filters combine with AND. |
| `filter2_value` | string | no | Value of filter 2; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas. |
| `filter2_condition` | `eq` \| `neq` \| `like` \| `nlike` \| `in` \| `nin` \| `gt` \| `lt` \| `gteq` \| `lteq` \| `null` \| `notnull` \| `from` \| `to` | no | Comparison of filter 2; Magento uses eq when left out. |
| `filter3_field` | string | no | Field of filter 3; filters combine with AND. |
| `filter3_value` | string | no | Value of filter 3; with like wrap it in %, with in separate values by commas. |
| `filter3_condition` | `eq` \| `neq` \| `like` \| `nlike` \| `in` \| `nin` \| `gt` \| `lt` \| `gteq` \| `lteq` \| `null` \| `notnull` \| `from` \| `to` | no | Comparison of filter 3; Magento uses eq when left out. |
| `sort_field` | string | no | Field to sort by, e.g. updated_at. |
| `sort_direction` | `ASC` \| `DESC` | no | Sort direction. |
| `fields` | string | no | Optional field list to keep the answer small, e.g. items[id,name],total_count. |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Results per page. Default 20. |
| `currentPage` | integer | no | 1-based page. |

### `magento_create_cart_price_rule`

Create a cart price rule (a discount, optionally with coupons). Magento requires the flags and counters listed in the rule example. Show the user the rule (who, what discount, which dates) and confirm before calling. Returns the rule with its rule_id; add codes with magento_add_coupon_code or magento_generate_coupon_codes.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /salesRules`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rule` | object | yes | Cart price rule fields, e.g. {"name": "Autumn 10%", "is_active": true, "website_ids": [1], "customer_group_ids": [0, 1], "coupon_type": "SPECIFIC_COUPON", "simple_action": "by_percent", "discount_amount": 10, "uses_per_customer": 0, "uses_per_coupon": 0, "from_date": "2026-11-01", "to_date": "2026-11-30", "stop_rules_processing": false, "is_advanced": true, "sort_order": 0, "discount_step": 0, "apply_to_shipping": false, "times_used": 0, "is_rss": false, "use_auto_generation": false}. coupon_type is NO_COUPON, SPECIFIC_COUPON or AUTO; simple_action is by_percent, by_fixed, cart_fixed or buy_x_get_y. |

### `magento_update_cart_price_rule`

Change a cart price rule, e.g. its dates, discount or active flag. Magento saves the rule object sent: read it with magento_get_cart_price_rule and send it back with the changes. Show the user the change and confirm before calling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /salesRules/{ruleId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ruleId` | integer | yes | Rule id. |
| `rule` | object | yes | The rule with the changes, including its rule_id. |

### `magento_add_coupon_code`

Add one coupon code to a cart price rule with coupon type SPECIFIC_COUPON and auto generation on, or replace its main code. Show the user the code and confirm before calling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /coupons`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rule_id` | integer | yes | Rule id. |
| `code` | string | yes | Coupon code. |
| `usage_limit` | integer | no | Total uses allowed; 0 for unlimited. |
| `usage_per_customer` | integer | no | Uses per customer; 0 for unlimited. |
| `is_primary` | boolean | no | true to make it the rule's main code. |

### `magento_generate_coupon_codes`

Generate a batch of unique coupon codes for a cart price rule whose coupon type is AUTO (or SPECIFIC_COUPON with auto generation on). Returns the codes. Show the user the rule and quantity and confirm before calling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /coupons/generate`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rule_id` | integer | yes | Rule id. |
| `quantity` | integer | yes | Number of codes. |
| `length` | integer | no | Code length without prefix and suffix. |
| `format` | `alphanum` \| `alpha` \| `num` | no | Characters used. |
| `prefix` | string | no | Prefix, e.g. XMAS-. |
| `suffix` | string | no | Suffix. |
| `delimiter` | string | no | Delimiter inserted every delimiter_at_every characters. |
| `delimiter_at_every` | integer | no | Spacing of the delimiter. |

### `magento_schedule_special_prices`

Add or update special prices of products for a store and period. Each entry needs sku, price, store_id (0 for all) and price_from and price_to (Y-m-d H:i:s). Invalid entries are skipped and listed in the answer; an empty list means all were saved. Show the user every SKU with its price and dates and confirm before calling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /products/special-price`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prices` | object[] | yes | For example [{"sku": "MUG-1", "price": 9.9, "store_id": 0, "price_from": "2026-11-20 00:00:00", "price_to": "2026-11-30 23:59:59"}]. |

### `magento_add_attribute_option`

Add an option to a select or multiselect product attribute, e.g. a new color. Returns the new option id. Show the user the option and confirm before calling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /products/attributes/{attributeCode}/options`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attributeCode` | string | yes | Attribute code, e.g. color. |
| `label` | string | yes | Admin label of the option. |
| `sort_order` | integer | no | Position. |
| `is_default` | boolean | no | Make it the default option. |
| `store_labels` | object[] | no | Labels per store view, e.g. [{"store_id": 2, "label": "Rot"}]. |

### `magento_set_source_items`

Set the stock of SKUs per Multi-Source Inventory source: quantity and status (1 in stock, 0 out of stock) for each sku and source_code pair. The quantity replaces the current one. Show the user the changes and confirm before calling.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /inventory/source-items`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sourceItems` | object[] | yes | For example [{"sku": "MUG-1", "source_code": "default", "quantity": 25, "status": 1}]. |

### `magento_search_cms_pages`

Search CMS pages (content pages such as about-us, shipping, terms) with id, identifier (URL key), title, active flag, meta data and the HTML content. Without a filter it pages through all pages. Example filter: field identifier, value %shipping%, condition_type like.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsPage/search`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | string | no | Field to filter on, e.g. identifier, title, is_active, page_id. |
| `value` | string | no | Filter value; with condition_type like wrap it in %, e.g. %shipping%. |
| `condition_type` | `eq` \| `neq` \| `like` \| `nlike` \| `in` \| `nin` \| `gt` \| `lt` \| `gteq` \| `lteq` | no | Comparison. Default eq. |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Results per page, e.g. 20. |
| `currentPage` | integer | no | 1-based page. |

### `magento_get_cms_page`

Read one CMS page by its numeric id, including the full HTML content, layout and meta data.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsPage/{pageId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | integer | yes | Numeric page id from magento_search_cms_pages. |

### `magento_search_cms_blocks`

Search CMS blocks (reusable content such as header, footer and homepage banners) with id, identifier, title, active flag and the HTML content. Example filter: field identifier, value %footer%, condition_type like.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsBlock/search`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | string | no | Field to filter on, e.g. identifier, title, is_active, block_id. |
| `value` | string | no | Filter value; with condition_type like wrap it in %. |
| `condition_type` | `eq` \| `neq` \| `like` \| `nlike` \| `in` \| `nin` \| `gt` \| `lt` \| `gteq` \| `lteq` | no | Comparison. Default eq. |
| `pageSize` | integer | no | Results per page, e.g. 20. |
| `currentPage` | integer | no | 1-based page. |

### `magento_get_cms_block`

Read one CMS block by its numeric id, including the full HTML content.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsBlock/{blockId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blockId` | integer | yes | Numeric block id from magento_search_cms_blocks. |

### `magento_create_cms_page`

Create a CMS page. page is {"identifier": "url-key", "title": "...", "content": "<p>HTML</p>", "active": true, "page_layout": "1column", "meta_title": "...", "meta_description": "..."}. The page goes live on the storefront when active is true. Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsPage`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | object | yes | The page fields, as described above. identifier and title are required. |

### `magento_update_cms_page`

Change a CMS page. Read it first with magento_get_cms_page and send page with its id, identifier and title plus the fields to change, e.g. {"id": 5, "identifier": "shipping", "title": "Shipping", "content": "<p>...</p>"}. Changes are live on the storefront at once (after the page cache refreshes). Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsPage/{pageId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | integer | yes | Numeric page id. |
| `page` | object | yes | The page fields: id, identifier and title always, then what changes. |

### `magento_create_cms_block`

Create a CMS block. block is {"identifier": "...", "title": "...", "content": "<div>HTML</div>", "active": true}. A block only shows where a layout or widget references its identifier. Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsBlock`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `block` | object | yes | The block fields. identifier and title are required. |

### `magento_update_cms_block`

Change a CMS block. Read it first with magento_get_cms_block and send block with its id, identifier and title plus the fields to change. Header, footer and homepage blocks change on every page that uses them. Installed switched off.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT {{MAGENTO_BASE_URL}}/rest/all/V1/cmsBlock/{blockId}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blockId` | integer | yes | Numeric block id. |
| `block` | object | yes | The block fields: id, identifier and title always, then what changes. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Magento (Adobe Commerce)** and enter `MAGENTO_BASE_URL`, `MAGENTO_ACCESS_TOKEN`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
